sources.locator: Full 397-page text inspected. Chapter 2 §§2.1–2.2, printed pp. 7–16; Chapter 3 §§3.1–3.3, printed pp. 17–21; Chapter 11 §§11.1–11.2, printed pp. 112–121.

contents.name: Chapter 2, §§2.1–2.2: regular solution curves, kernel complements, tangents and bordered hyperplanes.
Chapter 11, §§11.1–11.2: contraction-based local existence and uniqueness methods; the local quantitative residual-error bound here is independently derived.
Chapter 2, §§2.1–2.2: implicit regular curve charts, tangent orientation and predictor geometry.
Chapter 2, §§2.1–2.2 and Chapter 3, §§3.1–3.3: tangent-plane continuation and local corrector sections.
Chapter 3, §§3.1–3.3: local continuation and corrector context; the fold reduction and curvature proof are taken up in the independent Acta Numerica treatment and proved locally.
Chapter 3, §§3.1–3.3, printed pp. 17–21: predictor-corrector and pseudo-arclength Newton systems.
Chapters 2–3, printed pp. 7–27: regular curve tangents, predictor-corrector steps and Newton correction.
